summary_md: **TetiAI ([@TetiAI_](https://x.com/TetiAI_/status/2116151204103458856))** introduces **Dynamic Engram**, which injects new memories at inference as exact n-gram memory without retraining or long prompts; a 350M model answers 95.5% of unseen memories correctly and runs faster than RAG on CPU ([Zenodo paper](https://zenodo.org/records/23803703), [tetiai/dynamic-engram-350m](https://huggingface.co/tetiai/dynamic-engram-350m)).

referenced_urls.title: Dynamic Engram: Answering from an Exact n-gram Memory Injected at Inference Time

relevance: Alternative memory mechanism for small local models.
